human_questions.question: Num 10:10, first word. Is any accent printed on וּבְיוֹם, above the yod or below it? The line crop cuts off the area above the line.
Is there a meteg under the initial shuruk-vav (וּֽ)? Yes or no.
Is a darga (or another accent) printed under the yod of וְהָיוּ? If so, which one?
There is a munah-shaped mark under this word. Is it under the second lamed (עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶם) or under the tav (עֹלֹתֵ֣יכֶם)?
In '(אַם שבת. זִכְרוֹן)', is שבת printed with any points (shin dot, patah, dagesh, qamatz), or unpointed? The candidate has שַׁבָּת.
There is a small raised mark at the upper left of the tav of אֶת (in אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה). Is it an accent (pashta/geresh) to be encoded, or a print artifact to be ignored?
There is a small mark between the וּ and the ר of הָאֲמוּרָה. Is it an accent or meteg on a specific letter (which one?), or an artifact?
On the dalet: is it sheva with dagesh (דְּ), sheva without dagesh (דְ), or segol (דֶּ)?
